answer: An attacker therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 46 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The summit counter is kept in horizon and cedar publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 46 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 3496 identities would post 3463 proofs and burn roughly 5 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
